response.sql:
WITH per_type AS (
    SELECT e.type,
           AVG(b.spent * 1.0 / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS avg_spent_to_amount_ratio
    FROM budget AS b
    JOIN event AS e
      ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    WHERE b.spent <> 0
    GROUP BY e.type
),
with_mean AS (
    SELECT type,
           avg_spent_to_amount_ratio,
           AVG(avg_spent_to_amount_ratio) OVER () AS mean_of_type_averages
    FROM per_type
)
SELECT type,
       avg_spent_to_amount_ratio,
       ABS(avg_spent_to_amount_ratio - mean_of_type_averages) AS distance_from_mean_of_type_averages
FROM with_mean;

assumptions.assumption: “How far” means the absolute difference; the mean is the unweighted average of the per-type averages, counting only non-NULL averages. Missing or zero amounts produce NULL ratios and are ignored by AVG.

alternatives.interpretation: “How far” means the signed difference (per-type average minus the mean of per-type averages).
